title: How Much Fiber in Pumpkin Seeds? 1.7g per Oz
description: Pumpkin Seeds: about 1.7 g of fiber per 1 oz hulled kernels (6% DV), from USDA FoodData Central. Portion table, comparisons, free calculator.

sections.heading: How much fiber is in pumpkin seeds?
paragraphs: USDA FoodData Central lists seeds, pumpkin and squash seed kernels, dried at 6 g of fiber per 100 g. One serving (1 oz hulled kernels (pepitas); 28.4 g) therefore has about 1.7 g of fiber and 158 calories. That is 6% of the 28 g Daily Value on U.S. Nutrition Facts labels, or 7% of a 25 g day and 4% of a 38 g day.
Pumpkin seeds are a good example of how much the shell matters. Hulled green pepitas are modest in fiber, while whole roasted seeds with the white shell have roughly three times as much per ounce.

sections.heading: Pepitas vs whole roasted seeds
paragraphs: Store-bought pepitas are usually hulled and sold for salads and trail mix. Seeds you scoop from a carving pumpkin and roast at home keep the fibrous shell.
Both forms are calorie-dense, roughly 125–165 calories per ounce.

sections.heading: How pumpkin seeds compare with other nuts, seeds, and treats
paragraphs: Of the 7 nuts, seeds, and treats on this site, pumpkin seeds rank #6 for fiber per typical serving and #5 for fiber per calorie. That works out to 1.1 g of fiber per 100 calories. Pumpkin seeds are calorie-dense, so the portion matters more than the fiber per gram.

Close neighbors by serving: [peanut butter](/fiber-in-peanut-butter) at 1.6 g (2 tbsp); [walnuts](/fiber-in-walnuts) at 1.9 g (1 oz (about 14 halves)); [flaxseed](/fiber-in-flaxseed) at 2.8 g (1 tbsp, whole). Across all 50 foods in the [fiber-in-foods table](/fiber-in-foods), pumpkin seeds are #48 for fiber per calorie.

sections.heading: Adding pumpkin seeds to your day
paragraphs: Roast seeds from a fall pumpkin with a little salt, or sprinkle pepitas over soups and salads for crunch.

Example: 1 oz pumpkin seeds, 1 cup butternut squash. Using the same USDA values as the calculator, that comes to about 8.3 g of fiber, with 1.7 g from the pumpkin seeds. Adjust the amounts in the calculator to match your plate.

faqs.q: How much fiber is in 100 g of pumpkin seeds?
faqs.a: 6 g, according to USDA FoodData Central (Seeds, pumpkin and squash seed kernels, dried). That is the figure every portion on this page is scaled from.

faqs.q: How much fiber is in pumpkin seeds (1 oz whole seeds in shell, roasted)?
faqs.a: About 5.2 g (Seeds, pumpkin and squash seeds, whole, roasted, without salt), for 28.4 g. Weigh your portion or edit grams in the calculator for a closer estimate.

faqs.q: Are pumpkin seeds high in fiber?
faqs.a: Whole roasted seeds with the shell are. Hulled pepitas are a moderate source.

faqs.q: Can you eat pumpkin seed shells?
faqs.a: Yes, roasted shells are edible and are where most of the fiber is. Chew them well.
